## Why visit

A tucked-away pub within the university district that offers a worthwhile route into Bollington’s cask beers without travelling to Cheshire. Its traditional room and student-union operation give it a different character from both the central heritage showpieces and the modern brewery taps. It is a sensible addition to an Oxford Road afternoon when the range is operating normally. The appeal is the combination of a proper pub, a regional brewery focus and a setting connected to Manchester’s everyday academic and cultural life.

## Beer

CAMRA describes a Bollington partnership, with most handpumps usually carrying that brewery’s beer, including pale and stout options.

## Plan the visit

Hours and cask availability can reduce outside university teaching periods. Verify rather than assuming six handpumps means six beers available.

**Getting there:** Walk from Oxford Road station via the university area; behind the Royal Northern College of Music.
